output.question: What is Best Buy's annual revenue?
output.answer: Best Buy Co., Inc.'s latest reported annual revenue was $41.691 billion for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, according to Fiscal.ai's financials/income-statement data linked to Best Buy's SEC filing [2](#cite-2). The filing reports revenue in millions, so $41,691 million equals $41.691 billion [2](#cite-2).

key_facts.fact: Best Buy reported annual revenue of $41,691 million ($41.691 billion) for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026.
The latest annual filing was filed on March 18, 2026.
